summary_brief: AI 编程工具生态迎来三个重要里程碑：Agent 技能系统标准化、智能安全机制生产就绪、AI 辅助工作流深度集成。OpenAI Codex、Claude Code、Zed、LangChain 等多个项目同时在技能扩展、审批机制、遥测监控等方向推进，标志着 AI 编程助手从实验性工具向企业级生产系统演进。

engineering_signals.title: Agent 技能系统标准化与互操作性演进
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: OpenAI Codex、OpenCode、LangChain DeepAgents 同时在推进技能系统标准化：Codex 引入 `.agents/skills/` 统一加载路径并废弃旧目录，OpenCode 将技能转为斜杠命令可调用，LangChain 添加 MCP 协议支持。这标志着 AI Agent 正从硬编码能力向插件化、标准化的技能生态演进，互操作性和复用性成为核心关注点。

engineering_signals.title: AI 编码工具安全机制生产就绪
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: OpenAI Codex 将 Smart Approvals 设为默认开启、Personality endpoint 提升为稳定版、引入 SQLite 日志数据库，同时 Claude Agent SDK 也同步升级审批能力。这些变更表明 AI 编码工具正在建立企业级的安全审计体系，通过自动化审批、操作日志追踪、渐进式迁移策略来平衡自动化与可控性。

engineering_signals.title: 模型可观测性与性能监控体系建设
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Codex 引入 WebSocket 遥测基础设施暴露请求时长和事件处理指标，Zed 编辑器集成 Zeta2 模型预测光标位置，显示 AI 工具正在从黑盒调用转向深度可观测。实时性能监控、意图理解与行为预测成为提升用户体验和系统可靠性的关键能力。

engineering_signals.title: AI 辅助编码工作流深度集成至 CI/CD
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Claude Code Action v1.0 GA 标志着 AI 编码能力正式进入生产就绪的 CI/CD 流程，Codex 推出计划模式增强复杂任务可控性，Zed 编辑器原生支持 Azure DevOps/GitLab。这些变更显示 AI 编码工具正从独立的辅助工具演进为开发流水线的核心组件，通过自动化审批、结构化规划、平台集成降低工作流触发门槛。

engineering_signals.title: 新一代模型适配与跨平台兼容性
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Fabric 集成 Claude 4.0 模型并扩展 1M 上下文支持，Nix 生态系统适配 Rust 1.91.0+ 工具链，Continue 和 OpenCode 修复 WSL/Windows PTY 兼容性。这些变更反映 AI 工具生态正快速适配新一代模型能力，同时致力于消除开发环境差异，确保混合系统环境下的稳定性。

releases.summary:
# 🎉 Claude Code GitHub Action v1.0 - Now Generally Available!

We're excited to announce the v1.0 release of Claude Code GitHub Action! This major release brings significant improvements in simplicity, flexibility, and power to AI-assisted development workflows.

## 🚀 What's New in v1.0

### Simplified Configuration
- **Automatic mode detection** - No more manual `mode` configuration. The action intelligently determines whether to run in interactive or automation mode based on your setup
- **Unified interface** - All prompts now go through a single `prompt` input, and all CLI options through `claude_args`
- **Better SDK alignment** - Closer integration with the Claude Code CLI for a consistent experience

### More Powerful & Flexible
- Direct access to all Claude Code CLI capabilities through `claude_args`
- Support for custom system prompts, tool configurations, and model selection
- Enhanced compatibility with AWS Bedrock and Google Vertex AI

## ⚠️ Breaking Changes

This release includes breaking changes from v0.x. Key deprecated inputs have been replaced with a cleaner, more intuitive API:
- `mode`, `direct_prompt`, `override_prompt` → unified `prompt` input
- `custom_instructions`, `model`, `allowed_tools`, `mcp_config` → `claude_args` with CLI format
- Other deprecated: `disallowed_tools`, `anthropic_model`, `trigger_phrase`, `timeout_minutes`

**📚 Please review our [Migration Guide](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code-action/blob/main/docs/migration-guide.md) for detailed upgrade instructions and examples.**

## 💡 New Use Cases & Examples

Explore the expanded possibilities with v1.0! We've created comprehensive examples showcasing various workflows:

- **Automated PR Reviews** - Intelligent code review on every pull request
- **CI Failure Fixes** - Automatically diagnose and fix failing tests
- **Issue Triage** - Smart categorization and response to new issues
- **Documentation Generation** - Keep docs in sync with code changes
- **Security Scanning** - Proactive vulnerability detection
- **And many more!**

**🔧 Check out all examples at [github.com/anthropics/claude-code-action/tree/main/examples](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code-action/tree/main/examples)**

## 🏃 Quick Start

```yaml
# Interactive mode - responds to @claude mentions
- uses: anthropics/claude-code-action@v1
  with:
    anthropic_api_key: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}

# Automation mode - runs immediately with prompt
- uses: anthropics/claude-code-action@v1
  with:
    prompt: "Review this PR for security issues"
    anthropic_api_key: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
    claude_args: |
      --model claude-4-0-sonnet-20250805
      --max-turns 10
```

## 📖 Resources

- [Migration Guide](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code-action/blob/main/docs/migration-guide.md) - Step-by-step upgrade instructions
- [Examples](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code-action/tree/main/examples) - Ready-to-use workflow templates
- [Documentation](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code-action#readme) - Complete setup and configuration guide

## 🙏 Thank You

Thank you to our beta users for your invaluable feedback that shaped this release. We're excited to see what you'll build with Claude Code GitHub Action v1.0!

key_changes: 统一简化配置：自动模式检测，所有提示合并为单一 prompt 输入，CLI 选项通过 claude_args 传递
完整 CLI 访问：支持自定义系统提示、工具配置、模型选择，增强 AWS Bedrock 和 Google Vertex AI 兼容性
破坏性变更：废弃 mode、direct_prompt、custom_instructions 等 v0.x 输入参数，替换为更直观的 API
ai_summary.summary_cn: Claude Code GitHub Action v1.0 正式发布，这是一个包含破坏性变更的主版本升级。新版本通过自动模式检测和统一的 prompt/claude_args 接口大幅简化了配置，同时提供完整的 Claude Code CLI 访问能力和更强的云平台兼容性。从 v0.x 升级需要参考迁移指南，多个旧输入参数已被移除或替换。

releases.summary:
## New Features
- Added an optional SOCKS5 proxy listener with policy enforcement and config gating. (#9803)
- Plan mode now streams proposed plans into a dedicated TUI view, plus a feature-gated `/plan` shortcut for quick mode switching. (#9786, #10103)
- Added `/apps` to browse connectors in TUI and `$` insertion for app prompts. (#9728)
- App-server can now run in external auth mode, accepting ChatGPT auth tokens from a host app and requesting refreshes when needed. (#10012)
- Smart approvals are now enabled by default, with explicit approval prompts for MCP tool calls. (#10286, #10200)
- Introduced a SQLite-backed log database with an improved logs client, thread-id filtering, retention, and heuristic coloring. (#10086, #10087, #10150, #10151, #10229, #10228)

## Bug Fixes
- MCP tool image outputs render reliably even when image blocks aren’t first or are partially malformed. (#9815)
- Input history recall now restores local image attachments and rich text elements. (#9628)
- File search now tracks session CWD changes and supports multi-root traversal with better performance. (#9279, #9939, #10240)
- Resuming a thread no longer updates `updated_at` until the first turn actually starts. (#9950)
- Shell snapshots no longer inherit stdin, avoiding hangs from startup scripts. (#9735)
- Connections fall back to HTTP when WebSocket proxies fail. (#10139)

## Documentation
- Documented app-server AuthMode usage and behavior. (#10191)

## Chores
- Upgraded the Rust toolchain to 1.93. (#10080)
- Updated pnpm versions used in the repo. (#9992, #10161)
- Bazel build and runfiles handling improvements, including remote cache compression. (#10079, #10098, #10102, #10104)

key_changes: 新增 SOCKS5 代理监听器，支持策略执行和配置控制
Plan 模式升级：支持流式显示计划，新增 `/plan` 快捷切换和 `/apps` 浏览器
智能审批默认启用，为 MCP 工具调用提供明确的审批提示
引入 SQLite 后端日志数据库，支持线程 ID 过滤和日志保留策略
App-server 支持外部认证模式，可接受 ChatGPT 认证令牌
ai_summary.summary_cn: rust-v0.93.0 版本带来了多项重要功能增强，包括 SOCKS5 代理支持、Plan 模式流式显示、智能审批默认启用等核心特性。同时引入了 SQLite 日志数据库和外部认证模式，大幅提升了系统的可观测性和安全性。该版本还修复了多项 bug，包括 MCP 工具图像渲染、文件搜索和 Shell 快照等问题。

releases.summary:
## Core
- Sync changes
- Allow specifying custom models file path via OPENCODE_MODELS_PATH environment variable
- Ensure models configuration is not empty before loading
- Make skills invokable as slash commands in the TUI
- Don't follow symbolic links by default in grep and ripgrep operations
- Prevent parallel test runs from contaminating environment variables
- Ensure Mistral ordering fixes also apply to Devstral
- Add Copilot-specific provider to properly handle reasoning tokens (@SteffenDE)
- Respect OPENCODE_MODELS_URL environment variable in build process (@bbartels)
- Use snake_case for thinking parameter with OpenAI-compatible APIs (@Chesars)
- Bump AI SDK packages
- Ensure ask question tool isn't included when using acp
- Handle redirected statement treesitter node in bash permissions (@pschiel)
- Remove special case handling for Google Vertex Anthropic provider in response generation (@MichaelYochpaz)
- Exclude chat models from textVerbosity setting
## Desktop
- Revert transitions, spacing, scroll fade, and prompt area updates
- Add session actions tests (@neriousy)
- Refactored tests and added project tests (@neriousy)

**Thank you to 7 community contributors:**
- @neriousy:
  - refactor(app): refactored tests + added project tests (#11349)
  - test(app): session actions (#11386)
- @MichaelYochpaz:
  - refactor(provider): remove google-vertex-anthropic special case in ge… (#10743)
- @pschiel:
  - fix: handle redirected_statement treesitter node in bash permissions (#6737)
- @IdrisGit:
  - docs: update agents options section to include color and top_p options (#11355)
- @Chesars:
  - fix(provider): use snake_case for thinking param with OpenAI-compatible APIs (#10109)
- @bbartels:
  - feat(build): respect OPENCODE_MODELS_URL env var (#11384)
- @SteffenDE:
  - feat(opencode): add copilot specific provider to properly handle copilot reasoning tokens (#8900)

key_changes: 支持通过 OPENCODE_MODELS_PATH 环境变量指定自定义模型路径
技能可在 TUI 中作为斜杠命令调用
新增 Copilot 专用提供商以正确处理推理令牌
修复多个提供商问题（OpenAI 兼容 API、Google Vertex Anthropic 等）
改进测试框架：重构并新增项目测试
ai_summary.summary_cn: v1.1.48 版本主要增强了模型配置的灵活性，支持自定义模型路径和 Copilot 推理令牌处理，同时将技能功能集成到 TUI 斜杠命令中。此外修复了多个提供商的兼容性问题并重构了测试框架。

changes.description: 移除多个已弃用的输入参数（mode, direct_prompt, override_prompt, custom_instructions, model, allowed_tools, mcp_config, disallowed_tools, anthropic_model, trigger_phrase, timeout_minutes），统一替换为 prompt 和 claude_args
自动模式检测取代手动 mode 配置，不再需要手动配置交互或自动化模式
2026年2月之前的旧版模型将被弃用，建议迁移至新的 Claude Sonnet 4.0 或 Opus 4.0 模型别名
智能审批默认开启，MCP 工具调用现在需要显式审批
移除 WebSocket 线路格式，WebSocket 代理失败时会自动回退到 HTTP
弃用旧的 Web 搜索功能标志，相关配置行为发生变更
Rust 工具链升级至 1.93 版本
grep 和 ripgrep 操作默认不再跟随符号链接
使用 OpenAI 兼容 API 时，thinking 参数必须使用 snake_case 格式
移除了 Google Vertex Anthropic 提供商在响应生成中的特殊处理逻辑
聊天模型现在被排除在 textVerbosity 设置之外
